mechanism: Begin with one clearly adult trainee sustaining a directional physical task long enough to prove effort. Move into a second, mechanically different training action that serves the same objective. Introduce one visible instrument or countable checkpoint only after the effort baseline; let its result trigger a brief setback with observable physiological residue. Allow one bounded recovery action, then require the trainee to re-enter the same route or task direction before any emotional resolution. End on hydration, breath control or equipment reset plus a steady recommitment gaze—never an instant skill upgrade or victory. The reusable mechanism is effort, measurement, setback, bounded recovery, route re-entry and future commitment—not the source magical-girl design, hair, costume, road, park, watch, observers, tears, bottle, exact anime style, camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Prove sustained effort in one directional physical task before showing a result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate measurement provides no evidence of investment.

invariants.rule: Add a second mechanically different exercise that serves the same objective.
invariants.purpose: Shows training breadth without changing goals.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated activity fragments the attempt.

invariants.rule: Use one visible instrument or countable checkpoint to trigger the setback.
invariants.purpose: Externalizes why the trainee's interpretation changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated sadness makes the arc arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Keep brief physiological residue through one bounded recovery action, then visibly re-enter the same route or task.
invariants.purpose: Turns recovery into agency without erasing difficulty.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant neutrality or a cut to success skips the recommitment choice.

invariants.rule: End with a practical reset and steady commitment, not an immediate victory or power upgrade.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the payoff honest and reusable for persistence stories.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden triumph contradicts the measured setback.
